Then you add a menu link to it in the config and it would showed up in the sidebar. I have PR up that I believe will fix it , probably land tomorrow 🙂 https://github.com/open-rpc/generator/pull/731 For more context, the OpenRPC team has been talking and we think we'll commit to doing a documentation generation overhaul to our upcoming roadmap for the year. If you have any feedback or thoughts on things you'd like to see in that overhaul feel free to shoot me a DM 🙂 Great, will take a look once the new release is published!

excerpts.content:
<@403636673914863626> did eventually find the bug, there was an issue with the open-rpc-gatsby-theme code, originally you're able to just add md or mdx files to src/docs directory in the generated codebase.  Then you add a menu link to it in the config and it would showed up in the sidebar. 

I have PR up that I believe will fix it , probably land tomorrow 🙂 
https://github.com/open-rpc/generator/pull/731

For more context, the OpenRPC team has been talking and we think we'll commit to doing a documentation generation overhaul to our upcoming roadmap for the year. 

We are going to target having docusaurus as a base again and  styling to be more in line with something like https://mintlify.com  docs. 

If you have any feedback or thoughts on things you'd like to see in that overhaul feel free to shoot me a DM 🙂
